enrichment method: affinity kinase enrichment using the MIB-MS
HEK cell lysate was treated with DMSO and with two different concentrations (0.1 and 1 μM) of either ALMDAI26/OSA_820 or ALMDAI28/OSA_822 followed by affinity kinase enrichment using the MIB-MS.
